description: Adds artificial delay to requests matching a URL pattern, simulating slow networks or overloaded APIs. Use to answer: does the app show loading states when the API takes 3 seconds? Does it time out gracefully?

intercept_pattern.description: Glob pattern for requests to delay (e.g., '**/api/**')

latency_ms.description: Base delay in milliseconds to add to each matched request (default: 3000)

loading_selector.description: CSS selector for the loading state that should appear (e.g., '.skeleton-loader')

url.description: URL of the page to test

name: inject_latency
